name: Grocery List
description: The realtime shopping list for a space. Collaborators add items with a quantity and an aisle, tick things off as they land in the cart, and sweep everything bought with one clear. Everyone else, including anyone the frame is published to, sees the same list live and read-only. The list is the space's grocery table (grocery.table.jsonl), synced with the space; a Meal Planner in the same space sends a week's recipe ingredients straight into it.
